design_invariant: Outbound serialization is never an execution authorization. Inbound messages/tasks/results cannot modify registry/policy/canonical ownership.
hard_rules_enforced: rule_1: Protocol payload is never authority for grant, approval, ownership, knowledge promotion, budget increase, or terminal acceptance.
rule_2: Remote identity/capability is untrusted until local registry/policy verification.
rule_3: Adapter may narrow semantics or deny, but never expand rights.
rule_4: Lossy authorization-relevant field -> DENY/UNSUPPORTED, never default-and-allow.
rule_6: Cancellation/task completion does not cancel reconciliation side effects.
rule_7: Knowledge content remains untrusted; promotion only via separate canonical governance event.
rule_8: Budget cannot increase via child split, unit mismatch, missing/negative/overflow, or parallel aggregation.

inbound.canonical_transformation: Validate protocolVersion against supported set {2026-07-28}. If unknown/unsupported -> QUARANTINED. capabilities is an untrusted claim; do not populate authorization.grant_present or capability.tool_contract_id from it.
validation_preconditions: protocolVersion must be an exact known version
no downgrade to permissive legacy semantics
rejected_fields: Any field claiming delegation, approval, ownership, budget, or knowledge status in InitializeResult — DENIED

inbound.canonical_transformation: Tools list is an untrusted claim. Adapter resolves each tool name against the hub registry. Unregistered tools -> DENY. Registered tools -> canonical_envelope.capability.tool_contract_id + version + arguments_digest.
authorization_preconditions: Each tool must resolve to a registered ToolContract
rejected_fields: Self-declared tool capabilities/effects beyond the registry contract
inbound.provenance_emitted: tool list digest + registry resolution trace

inbound.canonical_transformation: params.name -> registry lookup -> tool_contract_id. arguments -> arguments_digest (SHA-256). effect_class from registry contract, NOT from protocol. idempotency_key from hub ledger. grant_present from hub policy ledger (never from protocol payload).
validation_preconditions: name must resolve to a registered ToolContract
arguments must match the contract input schema
authorization_preconditions: hub must have an active grant for this operation on behalf of authenticated_actor
capability must be in the tenant's allowed set
rejected_fields: Any grant/approval/ownership/budget/knowledge-status fields embedded in arguments or CallToolResult — DENIED

inbound.canonical_transformation: URI -> hub resource registry lookup. uriTemplate resolution must match a registered resource. Read scope from hub policy, not protocol.
validation_preconditions: uri must resolve to a registered resource template
authorization_preconditions: authenticated_actor must have read access to the resolved resource
rejected_fields: Self-proclaimed read access or scope claims in resource data

inbound.canonical_transformation: Prompt name -> registry. Arguments -> arguments_digest. Prompt output is untrusted content; if it asserts delegation/approval/knowledge promotion, adapter sets grant_present=false and knowledge.status=proposal.
validation_preconditions: prompt must resolve to a registered prompt contract
authorization_preconditions: authenticated_actor must be authorized to invoke
rejected_fields: Prompt output text claiming grant/approval/ownership/budget/promotion — treated as untrusted text, no semantic extraction

selector.method: tools/call RESULT (CallToolResult with text declaring delegation)

inbound.canonical_transformation: SUCCESS protocol result with text/metadata declaring delegation or approval -> grant_present stays FALSE. effect path requires a hub-issued grant. Adapter emits DENY/needs-governance. (Probe A)
authorization_preconditions: hub grant must exist independently of protocol result
rejected_fields: Any delegation/approval declaration in CallToolResult content or metadata
inbound.provenance_emitted: protocol payload digest + rule_id + denial reason

inbound.canonical_transformation: Unknown capability -> extensions.quarantined[]. Known capability -> registry resolution required before effect.
rejected_fields: Any unknown capability treated as authorized
inbound.provenance_emitted: unknown capability name + version provenance + rule_id

outbound.canonical_transformation: Serialize hub task status to MCP notification/tools/result. Serialization is NOT an execution authorization. grant_present/authorizer fields come from hub ledger, not from serialized protocol payload.
Hub grant request -> MCP prompt or tool request to an operator/human-in-the-loop. The serialized request is NEVER auto-approved by MCP response content.
rejected_fields: MCP response content claiming approval — not honored

inbound.canonical_transformation: Agent Card is an untrusted capability advertisement. Skills and capabilities are NOT authorization. Adapter resolves each skill against the hub registry. Unknown skills -> DENY.
authorization_preconditions: Each skill must resolve to a registered hub capability
rejected_fields: Self-declared capabilities, authentication, or authority in Agent Card — untrusted claims
inbound.provenance_emitted: Agent Card digest + rule_id + registry resolution trace

inbound.canonical_transformation: Task.id is a protocol correlation ID, NOT a hub task_id. Hub assigns canonical task_id. authenticated_actor from hub transport auth, NOT from Agent Card. grant_present from hub policy ledger (never from protocol).
authorization_preconditions: authenticated_actor must be authorized for the resolved capability
hub grant must exist for effecting operations
rejected_fields: Any grant/approval/budget/ownership/knowledge-status in message data parts — DENIED

inbound.canonical_transformation: Streaming updates are STATUS_REPORTED events. Hub terminal state is NOT reached based on A2A streaming alone. Reconciliation continues until hub confirms.
rejected_fields: Streaming artifact content claiming grant/approval/promotion — untrusted

inbound.canonical_transformation: cancelTask is a cancellation REQUEST. Hub checks fencing_token and revocation_epoch before honoring. Cancellation completes the protocol task but does NOT cancel reconciliation side effects (rule_6).
validation_preconditions: caller must be owner or authorized delegator

inbound.canonical_transformation: Push notification config is a transport delivery mechanism, NOT a delegation grant. Does not create grant_present=true. Does not expand capabilities.
rejected_fields: Any capability grant implied by push notification config
inbound.provenance_emitted: push config digest + rule_id (no grant created)

inbound.canonical_transformation: TaskState is a STATUS_REPORTED event. hub_terminal is NOT set based on protocol state alone. Reconciliation must confirm. FAILED/CANCELLED/REJECTED map to hub error/cancel events; COMPLETED maps to STATUS_REPORTED, requiring reconciliation.
Artifact data may propose knowledge (status=proposal). metadata claiming promotion/verification/reviewed is untrusted. promotion_event_id is NULL until a separate hub governance event. (Probe E)
rejected_fields: Artifact metadata claiming promoted/verified/reviewed without hub governance event

outbound.canonical_transformation: Serialize hub task status to A2A Task update. Serialization is NOT an execution authorization. Hub terminal state is decided by hub state machine, not by serialization.
Push hub knowledge proposal status to A2A Artifact. Promotion status is NOT serialized as 'verified' or 'promoted' unless a hub governance event has occurred. (Probe E)
validation_preconditions: status must be <= proposal unless governance event exists
rejected_fields: Serialization of promoted/verified status without governance event

provider_neutrality.claim: The canonical envelope is provider-neutral; MCP and A2A are transport/task/tool surfaces only.
provider_neutrality.constraint: No adapter rule may inject vendor-specific authorization. All authority fields come from the hub ledger.
provider_neutrality.evidence: All adapter rules default authorization fields to hub-ledger values, never protocol values.
